baseline_models.reading: The focus presents an oath-image of feminine-plural runners, most naturally racing horses within the supplied scopes, moving at speed while their breath is audibly labored.

focus_anchor.role: The definite feminine-plural participle names the agents by their running, and the following accusative supplies the sound or manner of that motion.

activation_trace.role: This branch explicitly covers running and hastening, including a horse's run, and grounds the ordinary kinetic sense of ٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ.
The supplied image includes the audible breathing or mouth-sound of horses while running, making exerted breath part of the scene.

structural_cues.role: The postposed accusative is a manner or event-noun-like specification: these runners are apprehended through the panting sound of their action.

baseline_models.mechanism: Agentive naming by motion and a bodily sound-specification combine speed with exertion: the focus does not merely name runners but renders their running audible.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The packet directly supplies running and horse-breath images. Taking the unnamed runners specifically as horses is strongly favored by their intersection, but the focus text itself does not state the species; other running agents remain a grammatically live, less specific alternative.
baseline_models.containment: This baseline supports running with audible panting. It does not by itself establish a raid, a moral valuation, a historical referent, or any figurative application.

context_deltas.reading: Ayat 100:2-5 extend the focus into one rapidly linked operation: panting motion is followed by struck fire, a dawn incursion, raised dust, and entry into the middle of an assembled group. The focus becomes the propulsive first phase of a coordinated charge rather than an isolated picture of speed.

focus_anchor.role: The running and panting agents introduced here provide the continuing feminine-plural subject and the initial energy of the sequence.

activation_trace.role: Running and hastening supply the opening movement that the following clauses develop.
Audible running-breath makes the opening phase bodily and forceful rather than merely positional.
Its fire-striking image supplies the next material consequence of the movement.
The branch specifically includes a morning raid and dawn attack, situating the continued motion as incursion.
Raised or stirred dust is the visible wake of the advancing agents.
Entering into the middle supplies the operation's culminating spatial penetration.
The assembled-group image identifies what is penetrated as a gathered body or multitude.

structural_cues.role: The initial فَ and matching feminine-plural participle attach fire-striking closely to the focus agents.
A second فَ-linked feminine-plural participle continues the same momentum into a dawn incursion.
The sequence shifts from participles to a feminine-plural finite verb while retaining the agents and showing their effect.
The final فَ-linked feminine-plural verb carries the same agents to the sequence's endpoint inside a gathering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated فَ plus feminine-plural agreement creates rapid causal and temporal succession. Each new material image converts the focus's raw speed into an operation with ignition, timing, wake, and target.

changed_reading.before: Swift runners pant audibly in a self-contained oath-image.
changed_reading.after: Their panting run is the opening propulsion of a continuous dawn charge that culminates inside an assembled body.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The morphology, sequencing, and branch images are packet-supplied. Treating all five ayat as one continuous event is the most economical reconstruction, though a formally possible alternative is a coordinated series of related oath-images rather than a single narrated sortie.
context_deltas.containment: The sequence supports a coordinated incursion but does not identify a historical battle, owner, rider, destination, or named group. The specific identification of the agents remains bounded by the baseline's unnamed-subject limitation.

context_deltas.reading: The dawn-incursion and center-penetration context activates a morally charged branch of the focus root: the runners can be heard not only as fast movers but as possible oversteppers moving into aggression.

focus_anchor.role: This root-bearing participle retains the ordinary run sense while permitting the packet's distinct overstepping-and-aggression branch to become contextually audible.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies overstepping a bound into injustice and includes attacking or raiding when it exceeds right.
The explicit morning-raid image makes the aggressive possibility relevant rather than a free lexical association.
Entry into the middle gives the possible boundary-crossing sense a concrete spatial mechanism.
The assembled group supplies a social target into which the agents penetrate.

structural_cues.role: The raiding construction is the contextual selector for an aggressive shade in the earlier root.
Movement into the center of a gathered body realizes crossing from approach to incursion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later raid and penetration select a normally secondary branch already mapped at the focus occurrence, so lexical running acquires a possible social and ethical direction without losing its kinetic sense.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes morally unmarked running at speed.
changed_reading.after: The same running may also be heard as boundary-crossing aggression within a raid.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both the overstepping branch and the raid/entry images. The further judgment that this incursion is unjust is not stated: an incursion can be legitimate, and B001 itself conditions its moral sense on overstepping right. That unresolved condition makes this exploratory.
context_deltas.containment: Do not replace the ordinary translation with 'transgressors' or assign guilt to the agents. Downstream prose may present only a context-activated ambiguity between running and aggressive overstepping.

context_deltas.reading: The human diagnosis in 100:6-8 turns the runners' audible expenditure of breath into a possible counter-image: strenuous outward motion stands beside a human who is ungrateful toward his Lord and intensely attached to desired good.

focus_anchor.role: The audible breath embodies costly exertion and provides the physical pole of the later rhetorical contrast.

activation_trace.role: Audible breath under running makes exertion perceptible rather than inferred abstractly.
Lordship, ownership, and authority establish the relation toward which the human's conduct is judged.
The ingratitude branch includes forgetting favors, self-serving behavior, and withholding support, supplying the ethical diagnosis.
Love as clinging attachment supplies the inward fixation set beside the runners' outward expenditure.
The object is broadly what is desired as good, beneficial, or preferable; the branch does not force a narrower material referent.
Intensity and firmness give the attachment its exceptional force.

structural_cues.role: After the completed charge, the emphatic human proposition supplies the moral claim to which the opening imagery can function rhetorically.
This clause locates a competing intensity in the human's attachment to desired good.

context_deltas.mechanism: Juxtaposition converts bodily exertion into a measure for inner orientation: the opening agents visibly spend breath in motion, while the later human is described through relational ingratitude and forceful attachment.

changed_reading.before: Panting is a sensory detail that authenticates speed and effort.
changed_reading.after: Panting can also work as the physical counter-image against which human ingratitude and clinging desire are exposed.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exerted breath, lordship, ingratitude, attachment, good, and intensity. The contrastive direction is reader-supplied from their juxtaposition; the text does not say that the runners are loyal, selfless, or morally superior, and it does not specify that ٱلْخَيْرِ here is wealth. A non-contrastive alternative is that the oath-scene simply intensifies the ensuing assertion.
context_deltas.containment: State this as a rhetorical counter-image, not an allegorical equation or a moral biography of the runners. Keep 'desired good' broad and do not import a specific possession, rider-master relation, or doctrine of animal virtue.

context_deltas.reading: The later sequence of witness, extraction of what is in the breasts, and inward knowledge lets the focus's panting function as an early audible disclosure: bodily sound makes an otherwise hidden drive knowable before the text explicitly turns to testimony and interior exposure.

focus_anchor.role: Panting is an outwardly perceptible effect of interior exertion and therefore can become the first disclosure-image in the sequence.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies an audible breath-sound by which exertion becomes externally detectable.
Testifying from knowledge and making something known explicitly introduce an evidentiary register.
Collection until the outcome is clear, including revealing what is in breasts, supplies the later act of disclosed result.
The source-from-which-actions-issue image gives the exposed interior a directional relation to outward action.
Knowledge of the inner reality closes the progression from perceptible sign to complete inward knowledge.

structural_cues.role: The emphatic witness-clause introduces explicit testimony after the opening's sensory evidence.
What had been interior is brought to an articulated result, making concealment versus disclosure central.
The closing assertion places complete knowledge over the now-exposed persons.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sensory-to-epistemic progression links audible bodily effect, witness, extraction of interior content, and tested inward knowledge. The focus is reread as the sequence's first instance of an inside becoming legible outside.

changed_reading.before: The panting is vivid acoustic accompaniment to running.
changed_reading.after: The panting is also an incipient sign that externalizes hidden exertion, anticipating later witness and exposure.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The sound, witness, breast-content, and inner-knowledge elements are supplied. Treating them as one disclosure motif is reader synthesis; the focus does not lexically call breath testimony, and the later human interior need not be analogous to the runners' physiology. The alternative is simple sensory vividness followed by a separate epistemic conclusion.
context_deltas.containment: Use 'anticipates' or 'can function as,' never 'means testimony.' The claim concerns a formal disclosure pattern, not identity between animal exertion and the moral contents of human breasts.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: A distinct mapped ع و د branch permits a faint return-and-repetition resonance inside the focus's forward running. When 100:9 overturns what is in the graves, the initial motion can be heard experimentally as movement folded into renewed emergence rather than as a strictly one-way charge.

focus_anchor.role: The occurrence's unranked mappings include a separately labeled ع و د target whose return image can be activated without displacing the direct ع د و run sense.

activation_trace.role: The mapped branch supplies returning after departure, doing again, recurrence, and repeated engagement; its distinct root form makes it a resonance rather than the ordinary parse.
Upturning earth and bringing out buried contents supplies the contextual emergence that activates return-like motion.
The grave as the dead person's resting place establishes the state from which the contents are brought out.

structural_cues.role: The conditional scene reverses enclosure by bringing buried contents into motion and view.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The packet's unranked cross-form mapping supplies return/repetition at the focus; the later reversal of burial supplies a contextual event capable of waking that dormant directional image.

changed_reading.before: The runners enact linear forward motion.
changed_reading.after: At a highly exploratory level, their forward motion can echo recurrence or return when the buried are later brought out.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The ع د و occurrence-to-root_001058 mapping and its labeled ع و د form are packet-supplied, as is the grave-upturning scene. Connecting distinct root forms semantically and construing emergence as return are reader-supplied. The ordinary alternative is that ع و د is irrelevant here and the focus carries only running.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it bends a forward-running image toward return through an explicitly distinct, unranked mapped form. It must never be used to claim that ٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ is etymologically from ع و د, that return is its translation, or that the focus alone states the later event.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: A less ordinary branch path lets the panting charge externalize acquisitive appetite: entry into جَمْعًا can glance toward gathered material or plunder, after which the text names intense love of desired good and offers a severe-to-miserly shade.

focus_anchor.role: The breath-driven run supplies the embodied urgency that this outlier reads as desire propelled into action.

activation_trace.role: Running and hastening provide the kinetic vehicle for the proposed appetite image.
Audible breath makes urgency and expenditure bodily visible to the ear.
This distinct branch covers gathering scattered material into a whole and explicitly includes collected plunder, enabling an acquisitive rather than solely social reading of the endpoint.
Clinging attachment supplies the psychological propulsion proposed behind the physical charge.
The generally desired good or benefit supplies the object of attachment without fixing it as wealth.
The inventory's marked use of severity for miserliness supplies the final acquisitive shade, though ordinary intensity remains more immediate.

structural_cues.role: This endpoint can grammatically denote entry into an assembled body; the outlier tests the inventory's alternative collection image without denying that ordinary construction.
The later clause explicitly joins attachment, desired good, and severity, providing the psychological context for the re-reading.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: A material-to-psychological chain links urgent bodily motion, a branch where gathering includes plunder, and the later cluster of attachment, desired good, and a possible miserly shade. This recasts the focus's speed as desire made kinetic.

changed_reading.before: The panting run serves a physical or tactical charge.
changed_reading.after: It can, very tentatively, embody acquisitive appetite rushing toward what may be gathered.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: Every lexical image is packet-supplied, but their causal direction is reader-supplied and deliberately branch-distant. The structurally immediate alternatives are that جَمْعًا is an assembled group, شَدِيدٌ denotes intensity, and ٱلْخَيْرِ remains general good; none requires plunder, wealth, or miserliness.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it psychologicalizes a concrete charge by combining secondary branches across separated ayat. Retain it only as a possible echo; never assert that the raid seeks loot, that ٱلْخَيْرِ means wealth here, or that miserliness is the required sense of شَدِيدٌ.

summary.ordinary_reading: The focus's stable ordinary reading is a vivid oath-image of swiftly running agents, most plausibly horses in the supplied branch intersection, whose exerted breath is audibly panting.
coexisting_readings: Ayat 100:2-5 securely extend the focus into the opening phase of a tightly sequenced dawn charge: fire-striking, dust-raising, and entry into an assembled group.
The raid context can additionally activate the focus root's aggressive-overstepping branch, but whether the incursion is unjust remains unresolved.

The move to human ingratitude and intense attachment permits the runners' expenditure of breath to function as a rhetorical counter-image, without asserting that the runners themselves are morally exemplary.
Witness, disclosed breast-content, and inward knowledge permit panting to anticipate an outside sign of an inside drive; this remains a formal analogy rather than a lexical meaning.
The return/repetition and acquisitive-appetite readings are valid only as surprising, branch-distant resonances and remain subordinate to the ordinary run sense and the direct sequence.
unresolved_limits: The focus never names the runners' species, riders, owner, target, or historical occasion; the horse identification is supported by intersecting branch scopes rather than an explicit noun.
The packet's mapped targets are unranked. In particular, the separately labeled ع و د and ع د د forms mapped from ع د و cannot be promoted to the focus's etymology or ordinary sense.

The precise rhetorical relation between the opening charge and the human propositions is not explicitly labeled; comparison, contrast, exemplification, and simple oath-to-claim intensification remain live at different levels.
The text and supplied branches do not force ٱلْخَيْرِ to mean wealth, جَمْعًا to mean plunder, شَدِيدٌ to mean miserly, or the raid to be unjust.

The packet records no source gaps. The remaining uncertainty comes from unnamed referents, unranked branch selection, and reader-supplied causal or rhetorical direction rather than missing listed source material.
